events.factual_description: Public Records' official calendar lists 'International Anthem presents Josh Johnson – ANIMATIVE with Anna Butterss & Ben Lumsdaine' in the Sound Room on Thursday, December 10, 2026 at 7:00 PM and links directly to the authorized DICE ticket destination. Nonesuch Records independently announces the Brooklyn date as one of Johnson's Animative album-release shows and specifies that the live ensemble for these shows is a trio with bassist Anna Butterss and drummer Ben Lumsdaine. Nonesuch describes Animative, due October 23, 2026 on physical formats and digital download with streaming November 10, as blending skeletal soul-jazz, post-bop, electronic minimalism and dreamy ambience; Johnson uses saxophone to control a sampler or drum machine as part of the project's instrumental language. Public Records is at 233 Butler St in Brooklyn's Gowanus neighborhood.

en.why_it_matters: This is not just another Josh Johnson booking: Public Records gets the ANIMATIVE release trio itself, with Anna Butterss and Ben Lumsdaine. The project turns Johnson's saxophone into an interface with loops, samplers and drum-machine processes without surrendering the physical feel of improvisation, which makes the exact trio a strong Listening Notes intersection of instrumental identity, rhythm and electronics.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is in play in December, build the Brooklyn evening around the Sound Room and make room for this trio. From the DMV, I would pair the trip with another New York reason rather than make the train ride depend on this show alone.

es.why_it_matters: No es simplemente otra fecha de Josh Johnson: Public Records recibe al trío de lanzamiento de ANIMATIVE, con Anna Butterss y Ben Lumsdaine. El proyecto convierte el saxofón de Johnson en una interfaz con loops, samplers y procesos de drum machine sin perder la sensación física de la improvisación; ese cruce preciso entre identidad instrumental, ritmo y electrónica es muy Listening Notes.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York entra en juego en diciembre, armaría la noche de Brooklyn alrededor del Sound Room y sí le haría espacio a este trío. Desde el DMV lo combinaría con otra razón para subir, en vez de hacer que todo el viaje dependa de esta función.
